top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.

top_violation_types.title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The classroom walls and window sills had pealing paint. In the Pre-K room one of the walls is stained and dirty. The peeling paint is in the reach of children. The floors in tile floors in the infant rooms are stained and dirty. This is not safe for the children to crawl on.

top_violation_types.title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the gatherings during the investigation, it was determined concrete evidence exists to support that the school have not followed the instructions on the sanitizing solution.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The van for transportation does not have a child safety alarm equipped.

top_violation_types.title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Observed that facility does not allow parents to have access inside the building to drop off children.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.
